lines.en: I tread the yellow stone of the End.
I'm taller than an ordinary stone one.
I press down with each step.
The rocks clatter as I move.
I skirt the edge of a floating isle.
My walk is steady and heavy.
I raise my head to the violet sky.
Rubble rolls away underfoot.
I swing my arms slowly.
I walk toward a vein of ore.
I paused once and went on.
I stop where the ground is wide.
I stand at the edge of a floating island.
My shadow falls into the void.
I gnaw at a chunk of ore.
The stones shift on my body.
The wind of the End carries no scent.
I plant my feet solidly.

lines.zh: 远处的响动传到我这里。
lines.en: A sound from far off reaches me.
I sink my whole body down.
The cracks in me creak.
I don't stir even one finger.
I'm waiting for something.
All this stone is mine.
I lift my hand and study it again.
You're standing before me.
I bring my head down to regard you.
I can't smell any use in you.
You're standing at the island's edge.
One step back and there's no ground.
I raise my mechanical arm.
You've backed toward the middle.
My palm is very large.
Do you eat ore too, perhaps?
Are you looking for a way out?
You're hunting for a way out.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪这颗石头脑袋。
lines.en: I tilt this stone head of mine.
There's a lot of empty air here.
A piece of rubble fell off me.
A stone chip flew; I turned aside.
A joint seized for a moment.
I steady myself bit by bit.
Some stones have come loose from me.
I stepped back half a pace and stopped.
This hardly qualifies as a wound.
I look down into the crack.
I pressed the stones tight.
I still haven't gone down.
Is that thing ore?
I sniff — it's stone.
I shuffle one step your way.
That won't fill my hand.
You're holding it up rather steadily.
I reach out for it once.
In my mouth it would vanish.
You can let your hand go.
This smell isn't quite right.
I spat it out in one go.
This ore isn't enough for one bite.
I'm watching what's in your hand.
You struck my shin and bounced.
I didn't shift half a step.
The stones clattered from the blow.
A small crack opened in the ground.
You pulled back even faster.
My stone foot grinds over the grass.
My weight bears down on this ground.
You nearly stepped off the edge.

lines.zh: 我的石掌，把你拨到一边。
lines.en: My stone palm nudges you aside.
This isn't something you can shove.

lines.zh: 我是石头和数码的混合。
lines.en: I'm stone and data together.
I don't quite understand this.
Standing side by side is fine.
Your stones are smaller than mine.
Let's guard this floating island.
My pace is slow; don't wait.
Our footfalls carry equal weight.
I'll keep watch on that side.
It's steady beneath the stone.
That is quite sufficient.
I pick up a piece of ore.
This one I can chew.
I press it into my mouth.
Your thing fell to the ground.
It got smaller in my hand.
I look at the veins in it.
Too little — not enough for me.
I return it to its place.
This isn't ore at all.
I fling it off with one hand.
You've set foot on my ground.
I twist my body to face you.
I set myself walking toward you.
Every step lands solidly.
Behind you is only emptiness.
I've raised my left hand.
I fix the bearing onto you.
The stones will fly at you.
Two strides are all that part us.
The stones ring underfoot.
We can start right now.
You've hidden behind a stone.
That stone isn't very large.
I've closed the distance slowly.
You're crunching all the rubble.

lines.zh: 你每一步都传到我脚下。
lines.en: Every step of yours reaches my feet.
I've picked up a stone.
I'm ready to throw it.
You're right at the island's edge.
There's no footing there.
Our distance keeps getting smaller.
This is the moment to move.
I bring my huge fist down.
You were knocked to your knees.
I shove you away with one hand.
A plate on your chest sank in.
A crater is left in the ground.
You caught yourself at the edge.
The stone fist falls; the ground cracks.
I used only half force there.
Can you rise at all?
I draw my fist back to my hip.
This matter ends here.

lines.zh: 我从浮岛的石堆里起身。
lines.en: I rise from the rubble of the floating isle.
The violet sky is above me.

lines.zh: 脚下的石块一块块拼好。
lines.en: The stones of my feet lock into place.
I start searching out ore.
My shadow drops into the emptiness.
I raise my head and scan the isle.
Wind blows fine sand across the island.
I hear a sound in the distance.
My joints clatter all the way.
I spread both arms out wide.
I stop walking and stand firm.

lines.zh: 石头做的我，慢慢地往前走。
lines.en: Made of stone, I walk forward slowly.
Fire heats my surface.
I fell and the stones shook.
Water seeps into my seams.

lines.zh: 冲击把我推得侧了半边。
lines.en: The shock pushed me half sideways.
A shot bounced off my stone hide.
That force shook me loose.
I haven't eaten ore in ages.

lines.zh: 雷光在我壳上炸成火花。
lines.en: The lightning burst to sparks on my shell.
Empty below; I'm falling.
